name: Hemoglobin subunit alpha
function: Carries oxygen from the lungs to tissues as part of the hemoglobin tetramer

name: Hemoglobin subunit beta
function: Carries oxygen as part of the hemoglobin tetramer; site of the sickle-cell mutation

name: Insulin
function: Hormone that lowers blood glucose by promoting glucose uptake into cells

name: Lysozyme C
function: Enzyme that breaks down bacterial cell walls

name: Calmodulin-1
function: Calcium sensor that regulates many enzymes and ion channels

name: Cellular tumor antigen p53
function: Tumor suppressor transcription factor that triggers cell-cycle arrest or apoptosis after DNA damage

name: Epidermal growth factor receptor
function: Receptor tyrosine kinase that drives cell growth signalling; drug target in lung cancer

name: Breast cancer type 1 susceptibility protein
function: E3 ubiquitin ligase involved in DNA double-strand break repair

name: Albumin
function: Main plasma carrier protein for fatty acids and drugs

name: Green fluorescent protein
function: Emits green light; widely used as a fluorescent tag in cell biology
